The term runs on the one-day deck of each case: the deck of the housing-audit case in weeks 1, 3 and 4, that of the immigration-and-trust case in weeks 5 to 7, that of the cohabitation case in weeks 8 and 9, and the full deck of the EU-frames case in weeks 10 and 11. Each week page opens the deck at the part that it uses.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Housing audit

```{=html}
<iframe class="slide-deck" src="../../slides/housing-one-day.html" title="One day – the housing-audit case – slides"></iframe>
```

Open the deck [in its own tab](../../slides/housing-one-day.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: the `d` key switches the optional runs of slides on and off, `[` and `]` jump between parts, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title.
